availability.note: Amendment 6: the style-control conditions are ragged. An unavailable problem x condition cell is a genuine hole -- no realization, no prompt, no activation -- and is excluded upstream of every model rather than imputed. Counted here so that availability is a reported number.

primary_endpoints.note: Two primary endpoints only. Amendment 1 demoted H1; it has no primary endpoint and no directional pre-commitment.

h2.endpoint: coefficient on answer-survival status in a discrete-time survival model for fork layer, cloglog link, person-period expansion

covariates_source.note: which measure fills each covariate key. The primary and robustness files share key NAMES so either drops into --covariates unchanged; this tag is the only thing that distinguishes them, and it is echoed into analysis.json so a robustness refit can never be read as the pre-registered primary.

h2.censoring_handling: right-censored pairs contribute all non-fork rows; none dropped, no fabricated event layer (DESIGN.md §A.9.1)

availability.note: Amendment 6: unavailable style-control cells are genuine holes -- no realization was built, so no fork layer exists. They are excluded upstream of the model, never imputed, and counted here. Right-CENSORING is a different thing and is handled inside the model; nothing below was censored by exclusion.

fit.note: The model could not be fitted. No coefficient is reported and none is imputed. The remaining analyses in this file were computed and are unaffected.

h2.secondary_endpoints_note: A pre-registered SECONDARY contrast for H2 (nl_break vs nl_minimal_orth, Amendment 6) is reported under the top-level `secondary_endpoints` key. It does NOT replace the endpoint in this block, whichever of the two looks better.

h3.endpoint: mean paired difference in per-layer-pair lambda2, formal minus nl_base, averaged across layer-pairs (Amendment 2)

permutation_null.permutation_unit: problem (condition labels swapped within a problem)

per_layer_pair.note: per-layer-pair permutation p-values (one-sided, less), Benjamini-Hochberg corrected across the layer-wise family (prereg decision 4). The PRIMARY H3 endpoint is the mean across layer-pairs, not any single layer-pair.

h3.lambda2_zero_note: lambda2 = 0 means the pooled transition graph is disconnected at that layer-pair for that condition. It is a real value, not a missing one; prereg decision 6's log-transform masks those 28 values wherever a regression is fitted.

secondary_endpoints.note: Amendment 6. Reported ALONGSIDE the primary endpoints, never in place of them. Neither entry below is a primary endpoint and neither becomes one by outperforming the primary.

h2_fork_hazard_break_vs_style_floor.status: PRE-REGISTERED SECONDARY (DEVIATIONS Amendment 6). This does NOT replace H2's primary endpoint -- the coefficient on answer-survival with the surface-dissimilarity covariates, reported under primary_endpoints.h2. BOTH are reported, and the primary is the primary whichever one comes out looking better. Promoting this contrast because the primary disappointed is the exact failure mode the pre-registration exists to prevent.
h2_fork_hazard_break_vs_style_floor.endpoint: hazard ratio for fork layer, nl_break vs nl_minimal_orth, in the cloglog discrete-time survival model
h2_fork_hazard_break_vs_style_floor.direction_precommitted: nl_break forks EARLIER than the matched-SITE style edit nl_minimal_orth: coefficient POSITIVE, hazard ratio > 1
h2_fork_hazard_break_vs_style_floor.matching: matched on edit SITE (the quantity anchor), NOT on edit magnitude: nl_minimal_orth is ~8x the edit size of nl_break (lex_edit means 0.0486 vs 0.0050, Amendment 6 correction). The pre-committed direction is therefore CONSERVATIVE -- the larger surface edit is the one predicted to fork LATER.
h2_fork_hazard_break_vs_style_floor.covariates_note: None, deliberately: the arms are matched on edit site by construction (Amendment 6), and a dissimilarity control that separates the two arms almost perfectly would only make the design near-singular.

availability.note: Amendment 6 unavailable cells are excluded upstream of the model, not entered as missing rows; both arms use the same problems.

survival_term.direction_precommitted: nl_break forks EARLIER than the matched-SITE style edit nl_minimal_orth: coefficient POSITIVE, hazard ratio > 1

h1_descriptive.status: DESCRIPTIVE (Amendment 1: H1 has no primary endpoint and no pre-committed direction; this is a methods note on the clustering front end, not a test)
h1_descriptive.note: DESIGN.md §A.7 / Amendment 1: the descriptive report is still stated at lambda = 0 (purely geometric affinity). Reporting it at lambda > 0 would be circular. Demotion does not change that.

path_entropy_normalized.note: conditional entropy of the transition chain / log k, in [0, 1]. Each condition is pooled over the problems where that condition EXISTS (Amendment 6: nl_minimal_orth and nl_minimal_lex are ragged), so the n_problems below differ by condition and the columns are not pooled over an identical corpus. Every cross-condition endpoint elsewhere in this file is computed on a common problem set instead; this table is descriptive.

lambda2_by_condition.note: computed on the COMMON problem set -- the 69 problems where ALL 6 conditions exist (Amendment 6: nl_minimal_orth 99/100, nl_minimal_lex 70/100) -- so the columns are comparable. Pooling each condition over its own problems would confound the condition with graph size, since lambda2 of the pooled transition graph depends on how many problems were pooled into it.

metric_correlation_matrix.note: DESIGN.md §A.8: correlation across the three retained metrics (lambda2, path entropy, fork layer), common index = layer-pair. Computed for EVERY condition present in the assignments -- all six under Amendment 6, the two style floors included -- against the reference condition; the reference itself has no fork-layer pair with itself and so is not a row.

formal.note: Common index is the layer-pair. Fork layer enters as the cumulative forked fraction by the end of layer-pair p; censored pairs never count as forked.
